title: comatype.config.json
description: Configuration of Comatype: which .comat directories (services) to read and which code to generate.

$schema.description: Location of this schema, for editor completion and validation.

services.description: Named units of an API. Each service has one comatDir and several targets.

additionalStatusCodes.description: Status codes that are not in the standard set, so that `sNNN` can use them.

comatDir.description: Where the .comat files of this service are, relative to this file. `comatype generate` scans it.

lang.description: Language to generate. `dart` is accepted but generating it is not supported yet.

role.description: Generate the client or the server side.

root.description: Where the project of that language is, relative to this file.

out.description: Output location under root. Defaults per language: ts/go `comatype`, python/ruby `comatype_gen`, rust `src/comatype_gen`, java `src/main/java/comatype/gen`, kotlin `src/main/kotlin/comatype/gen`, swift `Sources/ComatypeGen`, csharp `ComatypeGen`, dart `lib/comatype_gen`.

importPath.description: Go only. Import path of the output. If omitted, it is derived from the module of the go.mod found by walking up from root.

package.description: Java / Kotlin / C# only. Package name (C#: namespace) of the generated code. If omitted, it is derived from the path of `out` after src/main/java/ (src/main/kotlin/ for Kotlin), or `comatype.gen` (C#: `ComatypeGen`).

status.description: Status code. A code already defined as standard, or a duplicate, is an error.

message.description: Status message (such as `Custom Thing`). Used for OpenAPI descriptions and editor hover.
